sections.heading: Overview
bullets: An escort/crossing event protecting the NPC Desmina, run by two subgroups working at the same time rather than a single squad pushing together.

sections.heading: Squad split
bullets: Forward group (typically ~3 healers + 5 DPS): clears the route ahead and kills Enervators before they reach Desmina — an Enervator disables her protective dome and freezes her in place if it gets close enough.
Escort group (typically 2 players): stays glued to Desmina, keeping her moving and alive with healing and movement buffs.

sections.heading: Named attacks
bullets: <mark>Soul Siphon</mark>: the river itself ticks heavy damage on anyone standing in it (blockable/dodgeable) — falling off the river entirely is an instant kill, so watch your footing.
<mark>Soul Wave</mark>: rips a hit player's soul from their body — reunite with it in time or it's a death.
<mark>Soulless Torrent</mark>: damages and stuns anyone caught nearby — don't clump when it's incoming.

sections.heading: Other hazards
bullets: Hollowed Bombers channel bombs that hit Desmina for 20% of her max health — they have a defiance bar, and breaking it cancels the explosion outright rather than just interrupting it.
Spectral Rifts pull players toward them and need about 10 hits to deactivate.
Around 25% progression, a Spirit Horde of small ghosts starts chasing and stacking damage. Around 33% progression, Walls knock players into a ghost state if they touch you.
Time Bombs spawn on escort players — walk away from the group before they go off.

Players get one extra life — the first death turns you into a spirit that needs 5 purple orbs to revive, rather than an outright death. Don't play around it recklessly, but it's not a hard fail the first time either.
